name: Conquering
overview: Scripture reveals that conquering is ultimately rooted in the power and authority of Jesus Christ, who possesses all power in heaven and on earth (Matthew 28:18) and will return with great glory (Matthew 24:30). Believers are assured victory through His love, being more than conquerors in all circumstances (Romans 8:37). This conquering is not by human might but by Christ’s triumph, as exemplified by His overcoming and promise to share His throne with those who overcome (Revelation 3:21). The victorious Christ, symbolized as the Lion of Judah, has prevailed to fulfill God's redemptive plan (Revelation 5:5), contrasting the shame of abandonment in battle (Psalms 44:9) with divine triumph.
